title: Harnessing the Horse
subtitle: Reader Quick Start
promise: Move from reading to one governed delivery loop - with artifacts, gates, evidence, and human judgment intact.

pages.title: Your 30-Minute Orientation
pages.kicker: Do not browse everything. Build a mental map, choose one task, and leave with a next action.
steps: 0-5 min
Read START-HERE.md and choose the governed-session path.
5-10 min
Scan the Twelve Standards quick reference. Notice which controls are blocking, asynchronous, or advisory.
Read the Complete Session Loop. Identify the artifact produced at each transition.
Open the fictional worked example. Follow its Work Order, SPEC, DESIGN, generation prompt, implementation notes, review, and learning record.
Choose one prompt and inspect its expected output in prompts/manifest.json.
Pick one low-risk repository task and write its Work Order. Stop before generation if acceptance criteria cannot be verified.
pages.callout: Success is not reading every asset. Success is knowing which artifact to use next and what evidence will let a human approve the change.

pages.title: One Governed Agent Session
pages.kicker: The loop turns model output into an engineering decision trail.
steps: 1. Orient
Load project rules, permissions, architecture, and the relevant source.
2. Contract
Write the Work Order and verifiable acceptance criteria before code generation.
3. Design
Define interfaces, blast radius, risks, and rollback expectations.
4. Generate
Give the agent a bounded contract and require explicit assumptions and verification markers.
5. Falsify
Run automated gates, then use a fresh review pass to try to disprove correctness.
6. Decide and learn
A human accepts, revises, or rejects the change; durable lessons update project memory.
bullets: Before generation: the contract, exclusions, risks, and required evidence are visible.
Before merge: automated results and an independent falsification review are attached.
After the decision: implementation notes and durable learning preserve why the result can be trusted.
pages.callout: Human judgment is a control surface, not ceremonial approval. Consequential ambiguity returns to a named owner.

pages.title: The Public Software Factory Model
pages.kicker: A truthful operating model, intentionally separated from private implementation topology.
bullets: Intake becomes a bounded Work Order before agents act.
Preflight verifies context, permissions, risk, and readiness.
EXPRESS provides a fast path only when evidence supports the classification.
Generation and verification remain separate responsibilities.
Quality gates produce evidence; humans retain consequential decisions.
Learning improves durable context without permitting uncontrolled self-modification.
pages.callout: Public diagrams teach lifecycle, gates, memory, and judgment. Exact filenames, inventories, backend priorities, database internals, and deployment topology remain private.

pages.title: Choose the Smallest Useful Artifact
pages.kicker: Start at the decision you need to make, not at the directory tree.
table: Testable acceptance criteria and explicit exclusions
Bounded output with assumptions and verification markers
Concrete counterexamples or an evidence-backed pass
Named owner, options, decision, and audit trail
One end-to-end governed task, not an orchestration platform
A learner can explain where gates and humans intervene
pages.callout: Copy the pattern, not the fictional domain. Replace every project fact, permission, threshold, and risk classification with evidence from your environment.

pages.title: A Safe 30-Day Adoption Sequence
pages.kicker: Earn autonomy through evidence. Do not begin with a fleet.
steps: Week 1 - Baseline
Choose one repository and low-risk task class. Record current lead time, rework, defects, and review load.
Week 2 - Govern
Add context, Work Orders, acceptance criteria, and existing CI gates. Run the session loop manually.
Week 3 - Falsify
Separate generation from review, capture escaped defects and false confidence, and tighten the weakest artifact.
Week 4 - Decide
Compare against baseline. Expand only if quality, control, and team comprehension improved together.
bullets: Stop if the team cannot explain why a gate exists.
Stop if approval lacks inspectable evidence.
Stop if private data or production authority exceeds the task's need.
Stop if speed rises while rework, incidents, or reviewer distrust also rises.
pages.callout: The goal is compounding engineering discipline: faster delivery because the system makes good decisions repeatable, visible, and correctable.
